title: All Languages Matter: Evaluating LMMs on Culturally Diverse 100 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance across 13 culture-specific domains (e.g., customs, heritage, religion) using culturally diverse images, and testing location-aware prompts to assess if geographic context influences model behavior or reveals cultural biases.

Comparing multimodal model accuracy, correctness, and fluency across 100 languages, specifically measuring performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages, as well as across 24 distinct scripts and 15 language families.
